affected_locations: Dakshin Bedkashi Union, Koyra Upazila, Khulna District, Bangladesh
key_impacts: 3,520 houses washed away in Dakshin Bedkashi
1,800 houses partially damaged in Dakshin Bedkashi
Coastal embankment breached in six places; 20.55 km damaged
Villages inundated twice daily by tides until embankment rehabilitation in 2013, delaying recovery
evidence_snippets: Cyclone Aila hit the Bangladesh coast on 25 May 2009 with 65-knot winds and 2–6 m storm surge.
In Dakshin Bedkashi, Aila killed 33 people, washed away 3,520 houses, and partially damaged 1,800; inundated almost the entire union.
Storm surge overtopped and breached the coastal embankment in six places, damaging 20.55 km of embankment.
